easy.def: A tool with a sharp blade for chopping wood.
examples: Dad used an ax to chop wood.
The ax is sharp.
Grandpa has an ax.

more.def: A tool with a heavy, sharp blade on a long handle, used for cutting wood.
examples: Dad used an ax to split firewood for the stove.
The ax is kept in the shed and is only for grown-ups.
The woodcutter swung his ax and the log split in two.
Dad chopped wood with an axe.
The axe is sharp.
I carried the axe.

more.def: A tool with a heavy, sharp blade on a long handle that is used to chop wood.
examples: Dad chopped logs with an axe.
The axe was very sharp.
He put the axe in the shed.

easy.def: An imaginary line that something spins around.
examples: The Earth spins on its axis.
A top spins on an axis.
The wheel turns on an axis.

more.def: An imaginary line through the middle of something that it turns around.
examples: The Earth spins on its axis once every day.
A wheel turns around a central axis.
The wheel and its axle share the same axis.

easy.def: A line along the side of a graph.
examples: The graph has an axis.
Label the axis.
The x axis goes across.

more.def: A line that runs along the side or bottom of a graph and is marked with numbers.
examples: The graph has two axes, one going up and one going across.
Label the bottom axis with the days of the week.
The numbers on the left axis show how many.
